theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ξ : MultiVector P (n + 1)) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), (∀ β : Euclid P →L[ℝ] ℝ, ξ (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (β.smulRight α)) = β (∑ i : Fin P, ξ (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((innerSL ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) : Euclid P)).smulRight α)) • (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) : Euclid P))) ∧ ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ Q → (∑ i : Fin P, ξ (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((innerSL ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) : Euclid P)).smulRight α)) • (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) : Euclid P)) ∈ Q
